observed.caption: Aerial view of a vast arid plateau with a dark escarpment ridge under a clear blue sky and hazy distant horizon.
observed.description: The photo shows a high aerial view looking across a wide, dry landscape under a clear blue sky that fades to pale near the horizon. A layer of pale haze covers the middle distance. In the center a long, dark, steep escarpment ridge runs across the terrain. The foreground and surrounding terrain is brown and reddish with textured gullies, darker green vegetation patches, and thin light-tan winding dirt roads and tracks. Small white and light-colored clustered structures are scattered across the land. On the far right horizon a faint flat-topped mountain peak is visible above the haze, with a thin white horizontal cloud band stretching across the horizon.
